blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Robust vision classifiers depend on large labeled datasets, but annotation remains expensive. Complementary-label learning (CLL) reduces this burden by using a simple form of weak supervision [ 33 ] : instead of assigning the correct class, each image is labeled with a class it does not belong to [ 13 , 4 ] . Telling that a photo is not a truck may take only a glance, whereas deciding whether an object in fog is a ship or an airplane can require closer inspection. This asymmetry makes complementary labels relatively easy to collect at scale, first from crowdworkers [ 35 ] and increasingly from vision-language models (VLMs), which can annotate millions of images at very low cost [ 28 , 42 , 43 ] . CLL is therefore a practical option for large-scale annotation in label spaces of up to about 20 20 classes, where current CLL methods are workable [ 29 ] , provided that errors in these labels can be handled reliably.
blocks.zh: 强视分类器依赖于大标签数据集,但注释仍然昂贵. 补充标签学习(CLL)通过使用一种简单的弱监督形式来减轻这种负担[33] :而不是指定正确的类,每个图像都标注一个不属于[13,4]的类. 说照片不是卡车,只能看一眼,而确定雾中物体是船只还是飞机则需要更仔细的检查。 这种不对称使得补充标签比较容易在规模上收集,首先是从人群工作者那里收集[35],并且越来越多地从视觉语言模型(VLMs)中收集,这些模型能够以非常低的成本对数百万图像进行注释[28,42,43]. 因此,CLL是标签空格中大规模注解的实用选择,最多可达20类,其中目前的CLL方法是可行的[29],前提是这些标签中的错误可以可靠地处理.

blocks.en: This condition matters because neither humans nor VLMs are perfect annotators. Both can occasionally assign the true class as the class an image does not belong to [ 35 , 28 ] . CLL is particularly sensitive to this diagonal noise (Figure 8 , Appendix A.2 ). A clean complementary label only rules out one incorrect class, whereas a diagonal label explicitly tells the learner to suppress the correct one. Even a small amount of such noise can destabilize training, and common techniques such as augmentation and label sharing can further propagate the error [ 27 , 23 ] . A practical CLL pipeline therefore needs a denoising method that works at dataset scale, does not depend on a particular annotator, and provides some indication of how reliable its own decisions are.
blocks.zh: 这个条件很重要,因为无论是人类还是VLM都不是完美的注释者. 两者偶尔都可以指定真实的类作为一个图像不属于[35,28]的类. CLL对这种对角噪声特别敏感(图8,附录A.2.). 一个干净的补充标签只排除一个不正确的类,而对角标签则明确告诉学习者压制正确的类. 即使是少量的这种噪音也会破坏培训,加固和标签共享等常见技术也会进一步传播错误[27,23]. 因此,实用的CLL管道需要一种解密方法,在数据集规模上运作,不依赖于特定的注释者,并在一定程度上表明其自己的决定是否可靠。

blocks.en: Data valuation offers a natural way to do this [ 10 ] . Among existing approaches, optimal-transport (OT) valuation is attractive because it is scalable and largely independent of the downstream learner [ 16 , 17 , 6 ] . OT valuation compares the training set with a small clean validation set using a cost that combines feature distance and label information, then uses the resulting dual potentials to estimate how much each training sample contributes to the transport. In LAVA [ 16 ] , for example, the label cost measures the distance between feature distributions associated with two label groups, one from training and one from validation. The difficulty in CLL is that these two sets use labels with different meanings: a training label c c means “not class c c ”, while a validation label c c means “class c c ”.
blocks.zh: 数据估价为做到这一点提供了一个自然的方法[10]. 在现有办法中,最佳运输(OT)估值具有吸引力,因为它可以扩展,基本上独立于下游学习者[16、17、6]。 OT估值将培训集与一套小型的清洁验证集进行比较,采用成本将特征距离和标签信息结合起来,然后利用由此产生的双重潜力来估计每个培训样本对运输的贡献。 例如,在LAVA [16]中,标签成本衡量了与两个标签组相关的特征分布之间的距离,一个来自培训,一个来自验证. CLL中的难度在于这两套使用具有不同含义的标签:培训标签c表示“不是c级c”,而验证标签c表示“c级c......”。

blocks.en: This semantic mismatch changes the valuation in a systematic way. Standard OT label costs implicitly treat samples carrying label c c as examples of class c c , but complementary labels violate this assumption by construction. The training group labeled c c is mostly a mixture of the other classes; class c c appears in that group only through annotation noise. As a result, the transferred label cost acquires an effective weight whose sign depends on the noise rate: it is positive above the crossover rate 1 / M 1/M for M M classes, zero at 1 / M 1/M , and negative below it (Figure 2 , left). The resulting valuation is therefore informative when noise is frequent, uninformative at the crossover, and reversed when noise is rare, where it can rank corrupted samples as the most trustworthy ones. This distinction is easy to miss because standard synthetic settings often operate above the crossover, where direct transfer appears to work. Real annotation errors are typically much rarer and lie below it, where the transferred score can perform worse than random. The same issue also affects valuation methods that interpret a complementary label as an ordinary class label, including KNN-Shapley [ 15 ] and Data-OOB [ 19 ] , which can similarly assign high value to diagonal noise (Figure 10 in Appendix C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 这种语义上的不匹配系统地改变了估值. 标准OT标签成本含蓄地将标有cc的样品作为c类c的示例处理,但补充标签通过构建违反了这一假设. 标有cc的训练组主要是其他班级的混合体;c类C只通过注音出现在该组中. 因此,转移的标签成本获得一个有效权重,其标志取决于噪声速率:对于MM类,它正高于交叉速率1/M1/M,0为1/M1/M,负于下(图2,左). 因此,当噪声频繁,交叉时无信息化时,产生的估值是信息化的,当噪声少时则倒置,可以将腐烂的样品列为最值得信赖的样品. 这种区分很容易被错过,因为标准合成设置往往运行在交叉之上,而直接转移看来是有效的. 真实的注释错误通常比较少见,并位于其下方,其中转移的分数表现会比随机差. 同一问题也影响到将补充标签解释为普通类标签的估价方法,包括KNN-Shapley[15]和Data-OOB[19],后者同样可以给对角噪声分配高值(附录C.4中的图10)。

blocks.en: We address this problem with CAVA, a complementary-label-aware data valuation method for CLL (Figure 1 ). CAVA keeps the OT formulation but changes the two components through which the semantic mismatch enters. First, the complementary label cost is defined between clean classes, so noisy complementary-label groups do not determine the cost itself (Figure 2 , right). Second, the label margin measures how much the observed complementary label contributes to the transport potential of a sample, using the same OT solution (Figure 3 ). For a diagonal-noise sample, the observed complementary label is its true class, which the clean validation set matches cheaply; its margin is negative whenever the validation set places the image in that class. Unlike the transferred score, the sign of the margin has the same meaning at every noise rate. It therefore gives an adaptive cut : the threshold is fixed at zero, the fraction of flagged samples adapts to the unknown noise rate without a pruning ratio, and the precision of this cut has a closed form in terms of the accuracy of the induced posterior classifier. CAVA uses that precision to decide what to do with flagged samples: they can be removed from the complementary-label pool or, when the detection is sufficiently reliable, recycled as ordinary-label supervision so that the detected error itself becomes useful training signal.
blocks.zh: CAVA是CLL(图1)的一种辅助标签-认识数据估价方法,我们用CAVA来解决这一问题。 CAVA保留OT配方,但改变语义错配进入的两个组件. 首先,互补标签成本在清洁类之间被定义,因此吵闹的互补标签组不能决定成本本身(图2,右侧). 其次,标签比值用同样的OT溶液(图3)测量观察到的补充标签对样品的运输潜力有多大的贡献。 对于对角噪声样本,观测到的补充标签是其真实的类,而清洁的验证组则廉价匹配;每当验证组将图像放入该类时,其比值为负. 与转移得分不同的是,比值的标志在每个噪声速率上都有相同的含义. 因此,它给出了一个适应性切除:阈值固定在零,标定样品的分量适应未知的噪声速率而不具有普鲁因比,而这种切除的精度在诱导后分级器的精度上具有封闭形式. CAVA使用这种精度来决定如何处理标注的样品:它们可以从互补标签池中移除,或者在检测足够可靠时,作为普通标签监督回收,这样检测出的误差本身就成为有用的训练信号.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We identify a flip law for transferred data valuation under complementary labels: the effective label-cost weight changes sign with the noise rate, making existing OT valuation blind at 1 / M 1/M and reversed below it, which is the regime relevant to real annotation errors. • We propose CAVA, an efficient denoising method for CLL, and show that the sign of its label margin has a fixed meaning across noise rates and numbers of classes. Its zero threshold needs no pruning ratio and has a closed-form precision that can be used to control the risk of recycling flagged samples. • On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise with AUC above 0.95 0.95 on label-free representations, and almost perfectly on a supervised one, in settings where transferred valuation performs worse than random; it improves a wide range of CLL objectives using only a fraction of the validation data, and scales to a one-million-image augmented pool. We also show that the detection is the agreement of a validation-induced posterior with the given label, which a fitted classifier matches, so the contribution lies in the corrected valuation and the recycling it enables, not in the transport solve.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下。 我们确定在补充标签下转移的数据估值的翻转定律:有效的标签成本加权值随噪音率变化而改变,使现有的OT估值在1/M1/M时变得盲目,并在下方倒置,这是与真实注解错误有关的制度。 我们提出CAVA,一种高效的CLL解码方法,并显示其标签比值的标志在噪声率和类数之间有固定的含义. 其零阈值不需要挤压比,具有闭式精度,可用于控制悬挂样品回收的风险. 在合成基准和人为基准方面,CAVA在无标签表示上将无标签表示值高于0.95 0.95的对角噪声分开,在转移估值表现比随机性差的环境下几乎完美地将无标签表示值区分开来;它仅利用一小部分验证数据改进了范围广泛的CLL目标,并放大到100万图像放大池。 我们还表明,检测是验证引起的后方同意给定的标签,该标签是安装的分类器匹配的,因此,其贡献在于纠正的估价及其促成的再循环,而不是运输解决方案。

blocks.en: 3 CAVA: C omplementary-Label A ware Data Va luation
blocks.zh: 3 CAVA: C辅助标签 A ware Data Va Luation

blocks.en: We first describe the direct transfer of OT valuation to CLL, which we call TW-LAVA, and show why it fails (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). We then introduce the two components of CAVA, the complementary label cost and the label margin (Section 3.3 ), and the selection and recycling built on them (Sections 3.4 and 3.5 ). Proofs are in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述了将OT估价直接转让给CLL,我们称之为TW-LAVA,并说明了它为什么失败(第3.1和3.2节)。 然后,我们介绍CAVA的两个组成部分,即补充标签成本和标签边距(第3.3节),以及在此基础上进行的选择和再循环(第3.4和3.5节)。 证据见附录B.1。

blocks.en: 3.2 Why TW-LAVA fails: a flip at η = 1 / M \eta=1/M
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 TW-LAVA为何失败:在 = 1 / M\eta= 1/M 上翻转

blocks.en: The noisy-group label cost assumes that the samples carrying label c c are instances of class c c . Under complementary labels they are not. If classes are balanced and a given label equals the true label with probability η \eta and is otherwise uniform over the other M − 1 M-1 classes, the group with label c c is the mixture 𝒟 ¯ c = ( 1 − α ) ​ P ¯ + α ​ P c , α ⁡ ( η ) = M ​ η − 1 M − 1 , \bar{\mathcal{D}}_{c}=(1-\alpha)\,\bar{P}+\alpha\,P_{c},\qquad\alpha(\eta)=\frac{M\eta-1}{M-1}, (3.6) where P k P_{k} is the feature distribution of class k k and P ¯ \bar{P} the average over classes. The group leans toward its own class when noise is frequent and away from it when noise is rare, and the label cost inherits this lean.

Under this noise model, (i) at η = 1 / M \eta=1/M the given labels leave the ground cost for any label divergence, so no score computed from the transport can separate diagonal noise from valid samples; (ii) for a squared mean-embedding label divergence, W grp ​ ( c , k ) = α ⁡ ( η ) ​ W D cl ​ ( c , k ) + r c + t k , W^{\mathrm{grp}}(c,k)=\alpha(\eta)\,W^{\mathrm{cl}}_{D}(c,k)+r_{c}+t_{k}, (3.7) where W D cl W^{\mathrm{cl}}_{D} is the same divergence between clean classes and the shifts r c , t k r_{c},t_{k} do not change the transport plan.

blocks.en: At the level of the transport plan, TW-LAVA therefore uses a clean-class label cost with the effective weight λ y ​ α ​ ( η ) \lambda_{y}\alpha(\eta) : positive above η = 1 / M \eta=1/M , zero at it, and negative below, where it rewards a given label that agrees with the validation class and reverses the score (the scores themselves coincide when the clean classes have equal radii; Appendix B.1 ). Part (ii) is exact for mean-embedding divergences; for the Sinkhorn class divergence of the pipeline we observe the same sign change with a smaller slope (Remark 1 ). Synthetic benchmarks sit above the crossover ( α = 1 / 6 \alpha=1/6 at η = 25 % \eta=25\% , M = 10 M=10 ), and human annotation errors sit below it ( α < 0 \alpha<0 on CLCIFAR-10, whose labels are not uniform, so the law applies there only qualitatively). On CIFAR-10 the TW-LAVA score crosses chance exactly at η = 1 / M \eta=1/M and is worse than random below it (Figure 9 , Appendix B.1 ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Task-wise selection
blocks.zh: 3.4 选择任务

blocks.en: CAVA selects within each task, which keeps every transport problem small and adapts the cut to each task. The fixed cut flags the fraction p p of each task with the lowest margins, as prior OT valuation methods prune a fixed fraction [ 16 , 17 ] . The adaptive cut needs no budget: its threshold is fixed at zero by Theorem 2 , so it flags exactly the samples whose given label is the most likely class, and the fraction it removes adapts to the noise rate of each task without knowing η \eta : I t rem = { i ∈ I t : s i ≤ 0 } , I keep = ⋃ t = 1 T ( I t ∖ I t rem ) . blocks.en:
We evaluate CAVA on MNIST [ 20 ] , CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20 [ 18 ] , the real-world CLImage datasets CLCIFAR-10/20 and CLMIN-10/20 [ 35 ] , an enlarged CIFAR-10-1M setting, and three further domains, FOOD15, RESISC45-20, and Places365-10, built from Food-101 [ 1 ] , NWPU-RESISC45 [ 2 ] , and Places365 [ 41 ] (Appendix C.1 ). All label spaces have at most 20 20 classes, the scale at which current CLL methods are workable: a complementary label excludes a single class, so its supervision weakens as the number of classes grows [ 29 ] .
For synthetic experiments, each training example receives an observed complementary label y ¯ i \bar{y}_{i} : with probability η \eta , we set y ¯ i = y i \bar{y}_{i}=y_{i} to create diagonal complementary-label noise; otherwise, we sample a valid complementary label uniformly from 𝒴 ∖ { y i } \mathcal{Y}\setminus\{y_{i}\} .
The test set always uses clean ground-truth labels. Unless otherwise stated, every valuation method uses the same validation set of N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 clean images, a class-stratified subset of the test split. The validation images are used only to score the training samples: they never enter model training, model selection, or the training objective. Test accuracy is measured after the final training epoch on the remaining 8,000 8{,}000 test images, which the valuation never sees, so no quantity is selected on the evaluation data. CLMIN-10 and CLMIN-20 contain 64 × 64 64\times 64 ImageNet images, which we resize to 32 × 32 32\times 32 ; their test splits hold only 50 50 images per class, so 20 20 per class form the validation set and the other 30 30 per class the evaluation set. This assumption is shared by the valuation baselines and is examined in Appendix D.8 . All valuation methods share one fixed feature extractor. The main tables use the supervised embedder of LAVA, which was trained with the clean labels of the training split and is therefore an upper bound on feature quality (Appendix C.2 ); Appendix C.5 repeats the detection and training experiments with two extractors that have seen no label of the pool, CLIP features and a network trained on the validation images only.
blocks.zh:

对于合成实验,每个训练实例都收到一个观察到的补充标签y i\bar{y}_{i}: 用概率 \ eta, 我们设置 y i = y i\ bar{ y} 来创建对角互补- 标签噪声 ; 否则, 我们从 Y\ { y i }\ mathcal{ 中统一抽取一个有效的互补标签 。 萨特米努斯 萨特米努斯 。 。 。

CLMIN-10 和 CLMIN-20 包含 64× 64\时间 64 ImageNet图像,我们调整大小为32×32 32\times 32;他们的测试分解每类只持有50个图像,因此每类20个组成验证集,其他30个组成每类评价集. 这一假设与估值基线相同,见附录D.8。 所有估价方法都有一个固定特征提取器。 主要表格使用LAVA的有监督的嵌入器,该嵌入器经过训练后带有训练分解的干净标签,因此是特征质量的上限(附录C.2);附录C.5重复了检测和训练实验,两个提取器没有看到池的标签,CLIP特征和一个只对验证图像进行培训的网络.

blocks.en: We compare against No Pruning and the transferred OT valuation TW-LAVA, and at small noise rates also against Random Pruning, SAVA [ 17 ] , KNN-Shapley [ 15 ] , Data-OOB [ 19 ] , and small-loss selection [ 11 ] ; LAVA itself enters the runtime and memory comparison (Appendix D.10 ). For CLL objectives, we evaluate FWD [ 39 ] , CPE [ 22 ] , OP [ 25 ] , SCARCE [ 37 ] , SCL-NL, and SCL-EXP [ 4 ] . All models use ResNet-18 [ 12 ] and are trained under the same protocol across compared methods. Full hyperparameters, seeds, single-run settings for expensive scalability experiments, and additional dataset details are provided in Appendix C . Table 2 fixes the names of the three OT valuation methods: LAVA is the original full-set method, TW-LAVA is its task-wise transfer to complementary labels (Section 3.1 ), and CAVA replaces the label cost and the score (Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: Real complementary labels are mostly correct: both CLCIFAR datasets have noise rates below 1 / M 1/M , the regime in which the noisy-group label cost of TW-LAVA reverses. Figure 6 reproduces this regime on CIFAR-10 with η ∈ { 2 % , 5 % , 10 % } \eta\in\{2\%,5\%,10\%\} and trains SCL-NL on the retained pool. All methods use the same feature extractor, the same 2,000 2{,}000 validation images, and the same task pools; each baseline is used as published, keeping the samples it values most (SAVA [ 17 ] , KNN-Shapley [ 15 ] , Data-OOB [ 19 ] ) or the samples with the smallest loss [ 11 ] . CAVA peaks at the cut p = η p=\eta at η = 5 % \eta=5\% and 10 % 10\% ( 82.2 % 82.2\% and 81.4 % 81.4\% ) and at p = 5 % p=5\% at η = 2 % \eta=2\% ( 82.6 % 82.6\% ; 82.3 % 82.3\% at p = 2 % p=2\% ), against 68.5 % 68.5\% , 38.7 % 38.7\% , and 7.9 % 7.9\% without pruning. TW-LAVA removes valid samples first, so pruning lowers its accuracy at η = 2 % \eta=2\% and 5 % 5\% and adds at most 4.6 4.6 points at η = 10 % \eta=10\% . Among the baselines, only Data-OOB keeps up with CAVA, and only below the crossover: it reaches 82.6 % 82.6\% and 82.0 % 82.0\% at η = 2 % \eta=2\% and 5 % 5\% , where its natural direction is the correct one (Figure 10 in Appendix C.4 ), but 11.0 % 11.0\% at η = 10 % = 1 / M \eta=10\%=1/M , where its score is blind. Random pruning, KNN-Shapley, and small-loss selection stay near or below no pruning at every noise rate, SAVA gains at most 8.1 8.1 points at η = 5 % \eta=5\% , and at η = 10 % \eta=10\% no baseline exceeds 12.4 % 12.4\% , while CAVA reaches 81.4 % 81.4\% .

In practice the noise rate is unknown, so a fixed ratio p p is hard to tune. The adaptive cut of Eq. ( 3.12 ) needs no ratio: it flags a different fraction in each task, and on MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and the two CLCIFAR datasets its flagged set reaches 96.0 % 96.0\% to 99.98 % 99.98\% precision and 87.2 % 87.2\% to 99.9 % 99.9\% recall (Tables 6 and 14 ), with a single OT solve per task. A score whose direction depends on η \eta , such as that of TW-LAVA, admits no such threshold. In training, the adaptive cut performs on par with the best fixed cut without choosing a ratio, except on CIFAR-20, and with recycling it is the best setting on five of the seven datasets (Table 1 ).

(3.12)的适应性切除不需要比例:它在每个任务中标出一个不同的分数,在MNIST,CIFAR-10,CIFAR-20上,CIFAR-20和两个CLCIFAR数据集的标定数据集达到96.0%96.0\%到99.98%99.98\%精度和87.2%87.2\%到99.9\%(表6和表14),每个任务只有一个OT解. 其方向取决于 \\eta 的分数,如 TW-LAVA 的分数, 不接受这样的阈值 。 在培训中,除CIFAR-20外,适应性切除与最佳固定切除相同,没有选择比例,回收利用是七个数据集中五个数据集的最佳设定(表1)。

blocks.en: Figure 10 in Appendix C.4 scores every method on the same pool and tasks, at the small noise rates of real complementary labels. KNN-Shapley [ 15 ] credits a sample whose label agrees with its validation neighbors, and a diagonal label agrees by construction, so it ranks the noise as the most valuable data on every dataset. Data-OOB [ 19 ] and small-loss selection [ 11 ] learn from the given labels themselves, so their direction follows the flip law: they are correct below the crossover 1 / M 1/M (CIFAR-10 at η = 5 % \eta=5\% and both CLCIFAR datasets), near chance on CIFAR-20 at η = 5 % = 1 / M \eta=5\%=1/M , and reversed above it (both datasets at η = 15 % \eta=15\% ). TW-LAVA follows the same law with the opposite sign: it is reversed on CIFAR-10 at η = 5 % \eta=5\% and on both human-annotated datasets, near chance on CIFAR-20 at η = 5 % \eta=5\% , and correct only above 1 / M 1/M , at η = 15 % \eta=15\% , as Theorem 1 predicts for the synthetic data and consistently with it on the human labels. Every score that reads a complementary label as an ordinary one therefore has a direction that depends on whether η \eta lies above or below 1 / M 1/M , which is unknown in practice. CAVA reaches the same detection inside the OT valuation framework, where the cut at zero and the precision of Theorem 3 come with the score at no extra cost. The transport solve itself is not what detects the noise: Theorem 2 holds for any validation potential, and on CLIP features the margin with the potential set to zero is within 0.006 0.006 AUC of CAVA on each of the five datasets where we computed it, and the marginal constraint of the transport lowers the AUC when the class marginal of the pool and of the validation set differ (Appendix C.5 ). The gain over existing valuation comes from the complementary label cost, which removes the flip, and from the margin, which isolates the label; the transport problem is the framework in which both are defined, not a better detector.
blocks.zh: 附录C.4中的图10以真实互补标签的小噪声率对同一池和任务上的每一种方法进行评分. KNN-Shapley [15] 信用于其标签与其验证邻居一致的样本,一个对角标签通过构造同意,因此它将噪声列为每个数据集最有价值的数据. 数据-OOB [19] 和小损失选择 [11] 从给定的标签本身学习,所以它们的方向遵循了翻转定律:它们正确位于1 / M 1/M(CIFAR-10 at η = 5%\eta= 5\% 和两个CLCIFAR数据集)的交叉下,在CIFAR-20上接近机会 = 5%= = 1% / M\eta= 5\%=1/M,并在上方反转(两个数据集均在 η = 15%\eta= 15\% ). TW-LAVA遵循相同的定律,反之则相反:在CIFAR-10上反之于 = 5%\eta= 5 和在两个人附加说明的数据集上反之,在CIFAR-20上近乎概率于 = 5%\eta= 5 \%,仅更正于 1 / M 1/M 以上,在 = 15%\eta= 15 上反之,如定理1预言合成数据并一致于人类标签上. 因此,每个将互补标签读作普通标签的分数都有一个方向,取决于oeta是否位于1 / M 1/M以上或以下,这在实践中是未知的。 CAVA在OT估值框架内达到相同的检测,其中零分的切和定理3的精度随分数而来,不需额外成本. 运输本身不是探测到噪音的原因: 定理2持有任何验证潜力,在CLIP上,可能设定为0的比值在我们计算该比值的五个数据集中每个数据集的CAVA 0.06 0.006 AUC以内,当池和验证组的类边距不同时,运输的边际制约会降低AUC(附录C.5)。 相对于现有估值而言,收益来自补充标签成本,该成本可以去除翻转,也来自比值,该成本将标签隔离;运输问题在于两者都被定义的框架,而不是更好的探测器.

blocks.en: Recycling detected diagonal-noise samples further improves both methods on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-20 and CAVA on all three synthetic datasets (Table 1 , block (b) against block (a)); for TW-LAVA with the fixed cut on CIFAR-10, accuracy rises from 76.04 % 76.04\% to 88.75 % 88.75\% . Detected diagonal-noise samples thus provide useful ordinary-label supervision when they are recycled with sufficient precision.

blocks.en: CLCIFAR-10 and CLCIFAR-20 contain 3.98 % 3.98\% and 2.32 % 2.32\% annotation errors, both below 1 / M 1/M , which is the regime where the label cost of TW-LAVA reverses (Theorem 1 ). Figure 4 (a) shows the consequence. With the noisy-group label cost, annotation errors and valid labels overlap, and at p = 3 % p=3\% only 43.5 % 43.5\% (CLCIFAR-10) and 9.9 % 9.9\% (CLCIFAR-20) of the recycled samples are true errors (Tables 16 and 17 ). With the complementary label cost and the label margin, the two groups separate almost completely under the same feature extractor and validation set: the recycled branch at p = 3 % p=3\% is 100 % 100\% true errors on CLCIFAR-10 and 75.9 % 75.9\% on CLCIFAR-20, where it already contains 98.0 % 98.0\% of all errors, and the adaptive cut on CLCIFAR-10 recycles 1,990 1{,}990 samples at 99.7 % 99.7\% precision. This selection quality carries over to training (Figure 4 (b)). CE+FWD rises from 31.28 % 31.28\% to 77.87 % 77.87\% on CLCIFAR-10 ( 82.14 % 82.14\% with the adaptive cut) and from 14.89 % 14.89\% to 43.67 % 43.67\% on CLCIFAR-20, and every objective improves on both datasets, including SCL-NL, which needs no transition matrix and reaches 80.00 % 80.00\% on CLCIFAR-10 with the adaptive cut, above known- Q Q FWD. The gain is largest for the recycling objectives, whose CE branch depends directly on detector precision (Theorem 3 ). The margin adds no OT solve: it reuses the validation potential of the same transport problem and evaluates M M soft-minima per sample. Full results are given in Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en: Trained from scratch with supervised CE, the 2,000 2{,}000 clean labels reach 71.52 % 71.52\% on CIFAR-10 and 43.08 % 43.08\% on CIFAR-20, against 91.57 % 91.57\% and 75.34 % 75.34\% for CAVA, which uses them only for scoring (Figure 5 (b)). CAVA keeps this advantage on a fixed representation that has seen no label of the pool: with CLIP features it reaches 87.91 % 87.91\% and 67.37 % 67.37\% (Appendix D.8 ), and the corresponding results on CLIP features for every dataset are in Appendix C.5 .

blocks.en: To evaluate CAVA beyond the regime where full-set OT valuation is feasible, we enlarge CIFAR-10 to one million training samples (CIFAR-10-1M) via label-preserving augmentation under the same diagonal-noise protocol ( η = 25 % \eta=25\% ). Task-wise decomposition splits the valuation into five tasks of 200,000 samples, and CAVA scores all one million samples in about 4 minutes. CAVA is best at the cut p = 25 % p=25\% that equals the noise rate and reaches 86.04 % 86.04\% with SCL-NL after 20 epochs, against 0.12 % 0.12\% without pruning. As Figure 5 (a) shows, it finishes this training before the valuation of TW-LAVA does, and TW-LAVA at its best cut p = 35 % p=35\% reaches 67.76 % 67.76\% under the same 20-epoch schedule and 71.05 % 71.05\% after 200 epochs, against 90.51 % 90.51\% for CAVA. Full results are in Appendix D.9 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have introduced CAVA, an OT-based data valuation framework for CLL. Starting from the task-wise transfer of LAVA, we showed that its noisy-group label cost carries an effective label weight λ y ​ α ​ ( η ) \lambda_{y}\alpha(\eta) that changes sign at the noise rate η = 1 / M \eta=1/M : the direction of its score depends on the noise rate, and the method is blind at the crossover, which is the regime of human-annotated complementary labels. CAVA replaces this cost by a complementary label cost defined between clean classes and scores each sample by a label margin, the part of its transport potential that the given label contributes. The sign of the margin has the same meaning on every dataset, flags diagonal noise with an adaptive cut that needs no pruning ratio, and comes with a closed-form precision that gates the recycling of detected samples as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and real-world benchmarks, CAVA with recycling is the best of the compared valuation methods on every dataset, and its gains are largest on real complementary labels, where the transferred method fails. The detection itself is matched by a classifier fit on the validation set, and the transport potential adds nothing to it; what the analysis contributes is the reason transferred valuation fails, a cost under which it does not, and a recycling rule gated by a precision that can be estimated from the validation set.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了CAVA,这是一个基于OT的数据评价框架,用于CLL. 从任务转移LAVA开始,我们显示其噪声组标签成本带有有效的标签权重QQ y α(η)\lambda_{y}\alpha(\eta),以噪声率QQ=1/M\eta=1/M改变标志:其分数的方向取决于噪声率,方法在交叉时是盲目的,这是人为附加说明的补充标签制度. CAVA以一个补充标签成本来取代这一成本,该成本在清洁类别之间被定义,而每个样本的分数则被一个标签差值,即给定标签所贡献的运输潜力部分. 边距的标志在每个数据集都有相同的含义,旗帜对角噪声带有适应性剪切,不需要剪切比,并带有闭式精度,将检测到的样品的回收门作为普通标签监督. 关于合成和现实世界的基准,回收利用的CAVA是每个数据集的比较估价方法中最好的,其收益最大的是真实的互补标签,而转移的方法在其中失效. 检测本身由符合验证组的分类器配对,运输潜力不增加任何附加物;分析促成的是转移估值失败的原因,成本不高,以及从验证组中可以估算出精度的回收规则。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: Our work has several limitations. First, we evaluate CAVA primarily on relatively small-scale CLL benchmarks; extending OT-based valuation to truly large-scale complementary-label datasets remains an open challenge [ 38 , 28 ] . Second, our framework assumes access to a clean validation set representative of the downstream task, a common assumption in data valuation research that may not always hold in practice; Appendix D.8 quantifies it. Third, recycling is most directly applicable to diagonal complementary-label noise, where a violated exclusion label reveals ordinary-label information. Addressing scalability, reducing reliance on clean validation sets, and generalizing recycling beyond diagonal noise are important future directions.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作有几个局限性。 首先,我们主要根据相对小规模的CLL基准对CAVA进行评价;将基于OT的估值扩大到真正的大规模补充标签数据集仍然是一个公开的挑战[38,28]. 第二,我们的框架假定可以获得代表下游任务的一套干净的验证,这是数据估价研究中的共同假设,但在实践中可能并不总是如此;附录D.8将其量化。 第三,再循环最直接适用于对角互补-标签噪声,在这种噪声中,被违反的排除标签会显示普通标签信息。 解决可伸缩性问题,减少对清洁验证装置的依赖,将回收范围扩大到对角噪声以外,是未来的重要方向。

blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: A.1 Optimal Transport for Data Valuation
blocks.zh: A.1 数据估价的最佳传输

blocks.en:
OT provides a principled framework for data valuation by quantifying how individual data points contribute to aligning empirical distributions in a task-aware and geometry-aware manner [ 34 , 31 , 24 ] . Let μ = ∑ i = 1 n a i ​ δ z i , ν = ∑ j = 1 m b j ​ δ z j ′ , \mu=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}\delta_{z_{i}},\qquad\nu=\sum_{j=1}^{m}b_{j}\delta_{z^{\prime}_{j}}, (A.1) denote empirical source and target distributions, where a ∈ Δ n a\in\Delta_{n} and b ∈ Δ m b\in\Delta_{m} are probability weights on the simplex. Here, z i z_{i} and z j ′ z^{\prime}_{j} denote generic source and target samples. In CAVA, these correspond to complementary-labeled training samples and ordinary-labeled validation samples, respectively.
Given a ground cost C ⁡ ( z i , z j ′ ) C(z_{i},z^{\prime}_{j}) that encodes task-relevant dissimilarity, the OT problem is defined as W C ( μ , ν ) = min π ∈ Π ⁡ ( a , b ) ∑ i = 1 n ∑ j = 1 m π i ​ j C ( z i , z j ′ ) , W_{C}(\mu,\nu)=\min_{\pi\in\Pi(a,b)}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sum_{j=1}^{m}\pi_{ij}C(z_{i},z^{\prime}_{j}), (A.2) where the transport polytope is Π ( a , b ) := { π ∈ ℝ + n × m : π 𝟏 = a , π ⊤ 𝟏 = b } . \Pi(a,b):=\Bigl\{\pi\in\mathbb{R}_{+}^{n\times m}\;:\;\pi\mathbf{1}=a,\;\pi^{\top}\mathbf{1}=b\Bigr\}. (A.3) Each entry π i ​ j \pi_{ij} represents how much probability mass from source sample z i z_{i} is transported to target sample z j ′ z^{\prime}_{j} , providing a natural mechanism for attributing importance to individual data points.

Following the calibrated OT valuation convention used in LAVA [ 16 ] , we remove this degree of freedom by using a zero-sum calibrated score. blocks.en: In data valuation, these calibrated OT sensitivity scores can be used to identify samples that increase the mismatch between training and validation distributions. Removing or downweighting samples with large positive scores can reduce the OT discrepancy and improve alignment with the validation distribution, as demonstrated in LAVA [ 16 ] . CAVA keeps this transport problem and replaces two of its ingredients for complementary-label learning, the label cost and the score (Section 3.3 ); the calibrated score v i v_{i} is the score of the TW-LAVA baseline (Eq. ( 3.5 )). Specifically, the generic source sample z i z_{i} becomes a complementary-labeled training sample ( 𝐱 i , y ¯ i ) (\mathbf{x}_{i},\bar{y}_{i}) , the target sample z j ′ z^{\prime}_{j} becomes an ordinary-labeled validation sample ( 𝐱 j v , y j v ) (\mathbf{x}_{j}^{v},y_{j}^{v}) , and the generic cost C C is the ground cost of Eq. ( 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 在数据估值中,这些校准的OT灵敏度分数可用于识别增加训练与验证分布之间不匹配的样本. 如LAVA[16]所示,删除或降低高正分的样本可以减少OT差异,并改善与验证分布的对齐. CAVA保留了这个运输问题,并取代其用于互补标签学习的两个成分,标签成本和分数(第3.3节);校准分数 v i v_{i}是TW-LAVA基线(Eq. (3.5))的分数. 具体地说,通用源样本z i z _{i}成为一个辅标训练样本(x i, y i) (\mathbf{x}_{i},\bar{y}_{i}),目标样本z j ′prime}_{j}成为普通标注验证样本(x j v, y j vi}i) (\mathb{x}_{j}^{v},y_{j}^{v}),通用成本C是Eq的地面成本(3.1).

blocks.en: Despite its effectiveness, Sinkhorn-based OT still requires storing and operating on the pairwise cost matrix, leading to 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ m ) \mathcal{O}(nm) memory complexity, or 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) when both empirical distributions have size N N . Recent works have addressed this limitation through minibatch or hierarchical OT approximations [ 17 , 44 ] . CAVA instead uses a task-wise decomposition, solving smaller OT problems between each complementary-label task and the clean validation set, which improves computational feasibility while preserving the distributional interpretation needed for data valuation.
blocks.zh: Sinkhorn基于的OT尽管有效,但仍需要在双向成本矩阵上存储和运行,导致O → (n mi)\ mathcal{O}(nm)内存复杂,或者O → (N 2)\ mathcal{O}(N^{2}),当两个经验分布都有N N 的大小. 近期的作品通过小批量或等级OT近似[17,44]解决了这一限制. CAVA转而采用任务分解法,解决了每个互补标签任务和清洁验证组之间较小的OT问题,提高了计算可行性,同时保留了数据估值所需的分布解释.

blocks.en: Compared to Shapley-value-based data valuation methods [ 10 , 15 ] , OT-based approaches avoid combinatorial subset enumeration and instead leverage distributional geometry to implicitly capture higher-order interactions. This makes OT particularly suitable for large-scale and continuous data settings, where valuation must account for domain shift, covariate imbalance, and sample diversity. Recent work has demonstrated the effectiveness of OT-based data valuation for dataset pruning, reweighting, curriculum learning, and active data acquisition [ 36 , 40 , 16 , 17 , 3 ] , positioning OT as a scalable and principled foundation for data-centric machine learning.
blocks.zh: 与Shapley-value-基于数据估值方法[10,15]相比,基于OT的方法避免组合子集点点点,而是利用分布几何来隐含地捕捉更高顺序的相互作用. 这使得OT特别适合大规模和连续的数据设置,在这种设置中,估值必须考虑到域位转移,共变不平衡,以及样本多样性. 近期的工作表明,基于OT的数据估值对于数据集的推算、重新加权、课程学习和积极获取数据[36、40、16、17、3]是有效的,将OT定位为以数据为中心的机器学习的可扩展和有原则的基础。

blocks.en: The recycled set I rec I^{\mathrm{rec}} is obtained by thresholding scores computed on the same pool, so its elements are not an i.i.d. sample drawn independently of the selection, and Theorem 4 and Corollary 1 should be read conditionally on the realized selection, with π det \pi_{\mathrm{det}} its realized precision; this is exactly the quantity we measure post hoc and report (Appendix D.7 ). An unconditional statement follows from a standard sample-splitting variant: compute the scores and the cuts on one half of the pool and apply recycling only to the other half. Conditionally on the first half, the selection region is fixed, the selected samples of the second half form an i.i.d. draw from it, and both results apply verbatim with m m the split size. We verified this device empirically with the TW-LAVA configuration (noisy-group score, fixed cut) on synthetic CIFAR-10 ( η = 25 % \eta=25\% , N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 , seed 1126 1126 ): scoring each half of the pool with the entropic c c -transform of the dual potentials fitted on the other half gives detector AUC 0.962 0.962 and recycled-branch precision 83.5 % 83.5\% , compared with 0.971 0.971 and 86.8 % 86.8\% for full-pool scoring, and end-to-end training on the split-fitted selection reaches 85.16 % 85.16\% against 86.33 % 86.33\% , so the unconditional guarantee costs about one accuracy point in practice. Because the per-task rules are one-dimensional thresholds, letting a fitted threshold be chosen on the evaluation half adds only the complexity of threshold classes, a union of families of VC dimension one that inflates Δ gen \Delta_{\mathrm{gen}} by a logarithmic factor; the adaptive cut of CAVA fits no threshold, so it adds nothing. Both devices change constants, not the structure of the bounds.

blocks.en: The bound separates two effects: the estimation term Δ gen \Delta_{\mathrm{gen}} shrinks as the recycled set grows, whereas false positives leave a bias floor 2 ​ ( 1 − π det ) ​ B 2(1-\pi_{\mathrm{det}})B that more data cannot remove. Recycling therefore helps only when the flagged set is pure, which is why CAVA recycles the adaptive-cut set, whose precision Theorem 3 gives in closed form, and why the selection-only objective is the default when that precision cannot be checked.

blocks.en: This section gives the datasets, the training and valuation settings, the metrics used to evaluate selections, and the baselines.
blocks.zh: 本节列出数据集、培训和估值设置、用于评价选择的衡量标准以及基线。

blocks.en: C.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集

blocks.en: MNIST [ 20 ] , CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-20 [ 18 ] (CIFAR-100 grouped into its 20 20 superclasses) receive synthetic diagonal noise: each training label equals the true class with probability η \eta and is otherwise drawn uniformly from the other M − 1 M-1 classes (Assumption 1 ); η = 25 % \eta=25\% unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh: MNIST [20],CIFAR-10,和CIFAR-20 [18](CIFAR-100组合成其20个超级) 接收合成对角噪声:每个训练标签均等于真班,概率为 o\eta,否则从其他M−1 M-1班(假设1)中统一抽取; 除非另有说明, = 25%\eta= 25\%。

blocks.en: CLCIFAR-10 and CLCIFAR-20 [ 35 ] pair the CIFAR training images with crowdsourced complementary labels; we use the first of the three labels per image, of which 3.98 % 3.98\% ( 1,990 1{,}990 images) and 2.32 % 2.32\% ( 1,161 1{,}161 ) name the true class. CLMIN-10 and CLMIN-20 from the same collection contain 5,000 5{,}000 and 10,000 10{,}000 ImageNet training images of size 64 × 64 64\times 64 , resized to 32 × 32 32\times 32 , with 4.80 % 4.80\% and 3.28 % 3.28\% such annotation errors. All four have error rates below 1 / M 1/M , the regime in which the label cost of TW-LAVA reverses (Theorem 1 ).
blocks.zh: CLCIFAR-10和CLCIFAR-20 [35] 将CIFAR训练图像配对为多源互补标签;我们使用每个图像的三个标签中的第一个标签,其中3.98%为3.98%(1,990 1{,}990图像)和2.32%为2.32%=(1,161 1{,}161)为真类命名. CLMIN-10和CLMIN-20同名收藏有5000 5{,}000和10,000 10{,}000 图像 64×64 64×64×64×64×64×32×32×32×32的训练画面,其中4.80%为4.80×,3.28%为3.28×3. 这四家公司的误差率都低于1 / M 1/M, TW-LAVA反向的标签成本(定理1 ) 。

blocks.en: Three benchmarks outside CIFAR and ImageNet receive the same synthetic diagonal noise ( η ∈ { 5 , 15 , 25 } % \eta\in\{5,15,25\}\% ). FOOD15 uses the first 15 15 of 20 20 dishes we take from Food-101 [ 1 ] (hamburger, pizza, sushi, ramen, steak, ice cream, french fries, caesar salad, fried rice, chocolate cake, donuts, dumplings, pancakes, spaghetti bolognese, tacos) with the official split ( 750 750 training and 250 250 test images per class); the training images of Food-101 were left uncleaned by its authors and may carry a small amount of label noise of their own, while the test images were cleaned. RESISC45-20 uses 20 20 of the 45 45 aerial scene classes of NWPU-RESISC45 [ 2 ] (airport, beach, bridge, church, desert, forest, harbor, island, parking lot, stadium, circular farmland, cloud, freeway, golf course, lake, mountain, railway, roundabout, ship, storage tank); the dataset has no official split, so the 700 700 images per class are split into 500 500 training and 200 200 test images with seed 1126 1126 . Places365-10 uses 10 10 scene classes of Places365-Standard [ 41 ] (airfield, beach, bedroom, bridge, forest path, kitchen, mountain, skyscraper, football stadium, outdoor swimming pool), with 4,000 4{,}000 training and 1,000 1{,}000 test images per class drawn from the official training set with seed 1126 1126 , since the official validation split holds only 100 100 images per class. All images are center-cropped and resized to 32 × 32 32\times 32 ; at 64 × 64 64\times 64 and 128 × 128 128\times 128 the accuracy did not improve in a pilot. Each dataset has its own feature extractor of the same architecture, trained on the clean labels of its training split and taken after the final epoch. The validation set holds 50 50 test images per class ( 200 200 for Places365-10), and accuracy is measured on the remaining test images.
blocks.zh: CIFAR和ImageNet以外的三个基准都收到同样的合成对角噪声(η { 5, 15, 25}%\eta\in 5, 15, 25} ). Places365-10使用10个场景班Places365-Standard [41](机场,海滩,卧室,桥梁,森林道路,厨房,山,摩天大楼,足球场,户外游泳池),有4000 4{,}000个培训和1000{,{}每班从1126号种子的正式培训中抽取的700个测试图像,因为官方验证分拆只持有每班100个图像. 所有图像都是中央编程的,大小调整为32×32 32\时;在64×64 64\时64和128×128128时,精度在飞行员中没有提高. 每个数据集都有自己相同的架构的特征提取器,训练其训练分解的干净标签,并在最终纪元后拍摄. 验证组每类持有50个50个测试图像(Place365-10为200个),并在其余测试图像上测量精度.

blocks.en: CIFAR-10-1M enlarges the CIFAR-10 training set to one million samples by label-preserving augmentation (Appendix D.9 ).
blocks.zh: CIFAR-10-1M将CIFAR-10培训套装扩大至100万个样品,通过贴标签加固(附录D.9 ).

blocks.en: Benchmarks with at most 20 20 classes are standard in CLL, and current CLL methods are workable only at this scale [ 13 , 7 , 4 , 35 , 29 ] , because a complementary label excludes a single class and the supervision weakens as the label space grows; extending CLL to larger label spaces is beyond the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 最多20个类的基准在CLL中是标准,目前的CLL方法只有在这个尺度上才可行[13,7,4,35,29],因为一个互补的标签排除了一个类,而且随着标签空间的扩大,监管会减弱;将CLL扩展到更大的标签空间超出了本工作的范围.

blocks.en: C.2 Training and Valuation Settings
blocks.zh: C.2 培训和估价设置

blocks.en: For all image classification experiments, we use ResNet-18 as the backbone network. Models are trained for 200 epochs with batch size 512 using stochastic gradient descent with momentum 0.9 and weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . The initial learning rate is set to 0.1 and decayed to 0.01 and 0.001 at epochs 100 and 150, respectively. We set random seeds to control data loading and training randomness. Table 1 and every table or figure whose caption says so report the mean ± \pm standard deviation over three independent runs with seeds 1126 1126 , 42 42 , and 2023 2023 , the same seeds for all compared methods; the other results are single runs with seed 1126 1126 . Unless a caption says otherwise, every method in a table uses the same feature extractor, the same 2,000 2{,}000 validation images, the same tasks, and AutoAugment, and accuracy is measured after the final epoch on the held-out test images. The recycling weight is κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 in all experiments. For computationally expensive scalability experiments such as CIFAR-10-1M, we report single-run results and explicitly mark them as such.
blocks.zh: 对于所有图像分类实验,我们使用ResNet-18作为骨干网络. 为200个批量大小512的纪元进行模型训练,采用具有0.9气势的划时代梯度下降和重量衰减5×10−4 5\times 10×4}. 初始学习率设定为0.1,在100和150世纪分别衰减为0.01和0.001。 我们设置了随机种子来控制数据加载和训练随机性. 表1和每一表或数字,如果其标题如此说明,则报告三个独立跑道的平均值±\pm标准差,其中种子为1126 1126、4242和2023,所有种子均相同;其他结果为单一跑道,种子为1126 1126。 除非一个标题另有说明,否则表格中的每一种方法都使用相同的特性提取器,相同的2000 2{,}000 验证图像,相同的任务,和自动调试,准确性在被搁置的测试图像上的最后纪元之后进行测量. 在所有实验中,回收重量为0.5\kappa=0.5。 对于CIFAR-10-1M等计算昂贵的可伸缩性实验,我们报告单运行结果,并明确标注为单运行结果.

blocks.en:
Following LAVA and SAVA [ 16 , 17 ] , the feature extractor ϕ \phi is a fixed pretrained network shared by every valuation method and baseline, so no method gains an advantage from it. We use the embedder released with LAVA for CIFAR-10 (which CLCIFAR-10 reuses) and networks trained the same way for the other datasets: a supervised PreAct-ResNet-18 trained with the clean ordinary labels of the training split, which is the same image set as the complementary-label pool (the LAVA network reaches 99.87 % 99.87\% on the CIFAR-10 training split and 93.07 % 93.07\% on its test split; LAVA describes its embedder as trained on the validation set, which this released network is not). CLMIN and the further domains have their own such networks, and CIFAR-10-1M an augmentation-matched one. We use its class logits (the penultimate 512 512 -dimensional features for CIFAR-20 and CLCIFAR-20). In the complementary-label setting such an embedder is an upper bound on feature quality, since it has seen the true label of every pool image, and it is the only component of the pipeline that has: the selection, the thresholds and the training never use a true label. The detection quality of the label margin is bounded by how well ϕ \phi separates the classes (Theorem 3 (i)), so weaker, label-free features lower the absolute numbers of every method without changing which method is better; Appendix C.4 reports all detectors on the same features.
Representations are L2-normalized and rescaled so that the median feature cost between pool and validation samples equals one. CAVA uses the ground cost of Eq. ( 3.1 ) with λ 𝐱 = λ y = 1 \lambda_{\mathbf{x}}=\lambda_{y}=1 , the 0 / 1 0/1 complementary label cost, entropic regularization ε OT = 0.01 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01 , uniform marginals, T = 5 T=5 random tasks of equal size, and a fixed class-stratified validation set of N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 test images (drawn once with seed 1126 and shared by all seeds and methods), used only to score the training samples and never for training. On CLMIN-10 and CLMIN-20 the test split holds only 50 50 images per class, so 20 20 per class form the validation set ( 200 200 and 400 400 images) and the other 30 30 per class the evaluation set. TW-LAVA uses the same feature extractor, λ 𝐱 = λ y = 1 \lambda_{\mathbf{x}}=\lambda_{y}=1 and the noisy-group label cost of Eq. ( 3.3 ); it is computed at the CAVA settings ( ε OT = 0.01 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01 , N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 ). The small-noise experiments (Figure 6 and Table 19 ) are the one exception: there TW-LAVA keeps the OT settings of its original implementation ( ε OT = 0.1 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.1 , label costs given by the OT distance between label groups), while still using the same 2,000 2{,}000 validation images as every other method. The direct score comparisons of Figures 2 and 9 recompute the noisy-group score at the CAVA settings (same normalized features, ε OT = 0.01 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{OT}}=0.01 , N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 ), so that only the label cost and the score differ.

blocks.en: Forward correction and CPE take a class transition matrix Q Q . As in their original papers and in the CLImage benchmark [ 39 , 22 , 35 ] , Q Q is the empirical transition matrix of the training pool (the known- Q Q protocol); it is the same for every method in a column, so it affects the objective and not the selection. The empirical Q Q of a noisy pool contains the diagonal noise rates, so these two objectives receive information that SCL-NL and SCL-EXP do not; our main results use SCL-NL, which needs no transition matrix, and CAVA improves it over TW-LAVA by 3.9 3.9 to 43.1 43.1 points on the CLCIFAR datasets, against 7.3 7.3 to 46.6 46.6 points for FWD (Table 1 , Figure 4 ).

blocks.en:
Several tables evaluate the two branches of Eq. ( 3.14 ) with the true labels, which are available for the synthetic benchmarks and for the annotated CLCIFAR datasets. In the actual CLL training setup, the true label y i y_{i} is not observed, and CAVA only uses ( 𝐱 i , y ¯ i ) (\mathbf{x}_{i},\bar{y}_{i}) together with the clean validation set.
However, in the synthetic benchmark, the original labels are known to the evaluator because diagonal complementary-label noise is artificially generated.
We therefore use y i y_{i} only after CAVA has completed selection and recycling, and only to evaluate the quality of the recycled and retained subsets.
The true labels are never used during training, OT valuation, threshold estimation, pruning, or recycling, apart from the fixed feature extractor described in Appendix C.2 .

除了附录C.2所述的固定特性提取器之外,在训练、OT估价、阈值估计、推算或再循环期间从未使用过真正的标签。

blocks.en:
The two selected subsets affect different branches of Eq. ( 3.14 ).
The recycled set I rec I^{\mathrm{rec}} is trained with the CE loss by treating the observed complementary label y ¯ i \bar{y}_{i} as an ordinary label.
If a recycled sample satisfies y ¯ i = y i \bar{y}_{i}=y_{i} , then the CE branch receives correct ordinary-label supervision.
If a recycled sample satisfies y ¯ i ≠ y i \bar{y}_{i}\neq y_{i} , then the CE branch receives an incorrect ordinary label.
Similarly, the retained set I keep I^{\mathrm{keep}} is trained with SCL-NL as the complementary-label branch, so any diagonal-noise sample remaining in I keep I^{\mathrm{keep}} still imposes a contradictory exclusion constraint.
Therefore, the quality of I rec I^{\mathrm{rec}} affects the CE branch, while the quality of I keep I^{\mathrm{keep}} affects the SCL-NL branch.

blocks.en: Theorem 2 holds for any validation potential, including w = 0 w=0 , where p i p_{i} is a kernel classifier over the validation set with bandwidth ε OT \varepsilon_{\mathrm{OT}} . The column “ w = 0 w=0 ” is therefore the exact ablation of the OT solve. Table 6 shows that it is within 0.006 0.006 AUC of CAVA on both representations and every dataset where we computed it: the potentials, which enforce that every validation image receives the same mass, do not improve detection. Two further settings test the one effect the marginal constraint can have. With N v ∈ { 50,100,200,500 } N_{v}\in\{50,100,200,500\} on CIFAR-10 (CLIP), CAVA reaches AUC 0.978 0.978 , 0.984 0.984 , 0.987 0.987 and 0.990 0.990 , and w = 0 w=0 is within 0.001 0.001 of it at N v ≥ 100 N_{v}\geq 100 and higher at N v = 50 N_{v}=50 ( 0.981 0.981 ). When the class marginals of the pool and of the validation set differ, the constraint forces mass onto the wrong classes: thinning five validation classes to 20 % 20\% lowers CAVA to 0.920 0.920 while w = 0 w=0 stays at 0.985 0.985 , and thinning five pool classes lowers CAVA to 0.983 0.983 against 0.994 0.994 for w = 0 w=0 . The transport is thus the framework in which the complementary label cost and the margin are defined, and with mismatched class marginals the margin without the marginal constraint ( w = 0 w=0 ) is preferable.

For every cut, Tables 14 , 13 , and 15 report the composition of the two branches of Eq. ( 3.14 ), measured by CE Contam. and CLL Contam. (Table 4 ), and the test accuracy with and without recycling. CAVA rows follow the protocol of the main paper; TW-LAVA rows use the original TW-LAVA protocol with 10,000 10{,}000 validation images.

blocks.en: Without selection, SCL-NL collapses to 1.66 % 1.66\% on MNIST, 5.10 % 5.10\% on CIFAR-10, and 2.25 % 2.25\% on CIFAR-20 (Table 1 ): the 25 % 25\% diagonal-noise samples teach “not the true class”, which a loss that treats every label as an exclusion cannot absorb. Every pruned configuration improves on this baseline by an order of magnitude.
blocks.zh: 没有选择,SCL-NL在MNIST上崩溃到1.66%1.66%,在CIFAR-10上崩溃到5.10%5.10%,在CIFAR-20上崩溃到2.25%2.25%(表1):25%的对角噪声样本教导“不是真正的阶级”,这种损失将每个标签都视为一种排斥,无法吸收。 每个被磨损的配置在这个基线上都改进了数量级.

blocks.en: Because the label margin ranks the noise at the low end of every task (Figure 11 ), the cut p = η p=\eta gives an almost oracle split on all three datasets: the recycled branch contains 0.70 % 0.70\% , 0.54 % 0.54\% , and 4.44 % 4.44\% valid labels on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-20, the retained pool at most 1.48 % 1.48\% diagonal noise, and p = η p=\eta is the best cut for the recycling objective CE+SCL-NL (Table 13 ). The adaptive cut flags nearly the same set without knowing η \eta (last CAVA row of Tables 14 and 15 ). TW-LAVA degrades with its detector: as its AUC falls from 0.9994 0.9994 to 0.9833 0.9833 and 0.9087 0.9087 , the valid labels in its recycled branch at p = η p=\eta rise from 1.24 % 1.24\% to 9.84 % 9.84\% and 24.34 % 24.34\% , which is why its best cut moves away from η \eta .

blocks.en: A cut larger than η \eta can only move valid labels into the CE branch, close to the floor ( p − η ) / p (p-\eta)/p of 28.6 % 28.6\% and 44.4 % 44.4\% at p = 35 % p=35\% and 45 % 45\% . It also changes the labels that remain: the lowest-ranked valid samples are those whose given label is a plausible class for the image, so over-pruning removes confusable pairs such as 4 ↔ 9 4{\leftrightarrow}9 and 1 ↔ 7 1{\leftrightarrow}7 and leaves a transition matrix with near-empty cells ( 14 / 90 14/90 cells at p = 45 % p=45\% on MNIST versus 0 / 90 0/90 at p = 25 % p=25\% , and 38 / 380 38/380 versus 5 / 380 5/380 on CIFAR-20; Figures 12 and 13 ). SCL-NL assumes uniform transitions and degrades accordingly (CAVA: 99.35 % → 79.50 % 99.35\%\to 79.50\% on MNIST and 81.67 % → 55.13 % 81.67\%\to 55.13\% on CIFAR-10 from p = 25 % p=25\% to 45 % 45\% ), whereas FWD, which estimates the transition matrix explicitly, is affected less. With TW-LAVA on CIFAR-20 the ordering is reversed, because the contamination left by its weaker detector outweighs this bias, so larger cuts help its selection-only training.

D.2 Real-world Complementary Labels: CLCIFAR-10 and CLCIFAR-20
blocks.zh: D.2 真实世界补充标签:CLCIFAR-10和CLCIFAR-20

blocks.en: CLCIFAR-10 and CLCIFAR-20 replace our synthetic corruption with human-annotated complementary labels: each of the 50,000 training images carries one crowdsourced complementary label, of which 3.98 % 3.98\% (CLCIFAR-10; 1,990 1{,}990 samples) and 2.32 % 2.32\% (CLCIFAR-20; 1,161 1{,}161 samples) are annotation errors, in which the worker selected the true class of the image as complementary. Two properties distinguish this regime from the synthetic sections. First, both error rates lie below 1 / M 1/M , so under the noisy-group label cost of TW-LAVA the effective label weight λ y ​ α ​ ( η ) \lambda_{y}\alpha(\eta) is negative (Theorem 1 ) and annotation errors sit on the high-score side; the TW-LAVA rules therefore flag the high-score tail here, the reverse of the synthetic benchmarks, where diagonal noise concentrates at the validation-consistent low end. Under the label margin of CAVA the errors sit on the low side on every dataset (Theorem 2 ), and the fixed cut flags the low tail as usual. Second, for TW-LAVA the errors are far harder to detect than synthetic flips (error-detection AUC 0.8790 0.8790 and 0.7243 0.7243 versus 0.9087 0.9087 – 0.9994 0.9994 in the synthetic regimes), because human mistakes concentrate on genuinely ambiguous images, whereas the margin separates them almost completely (AUC 1.000 1.000 and 0.999 0.999 , Figure 4 ); the pruning ratios are matched to the small error rates ( p ∈ { 3 % , 5 % , 8 % , 10 % } p\in\{3\%,5\%,8\%,10\%\} ).

blocks.en: Figure 4 (a) in the main text shows the score distributions. Under TW-LAVA, annotation errors ( y ¯ i = y i \bar{y}_{i}=y_{i} ) lie on the high side, the reverse of the synthetic setting (Figure 11 ), and overlap strongly with valid complementary labels (detection AUC 0.879 0.879 on CLCIFAR-10 and 0.724 0.724 on CLCIFAR-20); under CAVA they lie on the low side and are almost disjoint from the valid labels (AUC 1.000 1.000 and 0.999 0.999 ). For TW-LAVA, the two datasets place the detector at different operating points. On CLCIFAR-10, of the 1,500 1{,}500 highest-scoring samples (the top 3 % 3\% of the OT ranking, i.e. the CE branch at p = 0.03 p{=}0.03 ), 481 481 samples ( 32.1 % 32.1\% ) are actual annotation errors. Since errors make up only 3.98 % 3.98\% of the dataset, a random cut of the same size would contain ∼ 60 {\sim}60 ; the detector concentrates them 8.1 × 8.1\times above the base rate, so even shallow static cuts remove a meaningful fraction of the errors (residual 3.98 → 2.22 % 3.98\to 2.22\% at p = 0.10 p{=}0.10 ) and every pruned FWD run beats the unpruned baseline ( 51.76 → 59.4 51.76\to 59.4 – 67.3 67.3 ). On CLCIFAR-20 the detector is far weaker: the same 1,500 1{,}500 -sample cut contains only 117 117 errors ( 7.8 % 7.8\% , a 3.4 × 3.4\times enrichment over the 2.32 % 2.32\% base rate), the residual barely moves ( 2.32 → 1.73 % 2.32\to 1.73\% ), and static pruning yields only + 1.4 +1.4 to + 2.6 +2.6 points over the baseline.

blocks.en: On synthetic data, the combined objective performs well because the recycled CE branch has sufficiently high precision. On real-world complementary labels, however, the base rate of annotation errors is only 2–4%, so even a detector with useful recall can produce a low-precision recycled branch. Tables 16 and 17 show this clearly. For CLCIFAR-10, TW-LAVA at p = 10 % p=10\% captures 49.9 % 49.9\% of all annotation errors, but only 19.9 % 19.9\% of its CE branch consists of true errors. For CLCIFAR-20 at the same cut, it captures 32.9 % 32.9\% of the errors with a CE precision of only 7.6 % 7.6\% . Most of its recycled samples are thus valid complementary labels falsely treated as ordinary labels. Therefore, with the noisy-group score, real-world complementary labels call for discarding flagged samples rather than recycling them. The label margin changes this picture: at p = 3 % p=3\% its recycled branch consists of 100 % 100\% true errors on CLCIFAR-10 and 75.9 % 75.9\% on CLCIFAR-20 (Figure 4 ), which is why the recycling objectives gain the most in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 在合成数据方面,综合目标表现良好,因为回收的CE分支具有足够高的精度。 然而,在现实世界互补的标签上,注释误差的基准率只有2-4%,因此即使是一个具有有用回溯的探测器也能产生一个低精度的回收分支. 表16和17清楚地表明了这一点。 对于CLCIFAR-10,TW-LAVA at p = 10% p = 10\% 捕获49.9% 49.9\% 在所有注释错误中,但其CE分支中只有19.9% 19.9\% 包含真实错误. 对于同一切口的CLCIFAR-20,它捕捉32.9%的32.9%的误差,CE精度仅为7.6%7.6%. 因此,其大多数回收样品都是被错误地作为普通标签处理的有效补充标签。 因此,随着吵闹的组分,现实世界的补充标签要求丢弃标有标记的样品,而不是回收。 标签比值改变了这个图片:在p=3% p=3\%时,其回收分支由CLCIFAR-10上的100% 100\%真实错误和CLCIFAR-20上的75.9\%真实错误(图4)组成,这也是回收目标在表1中收益最多的原因.

blocks.en:
The uniform-transition assumption of SCL-NL is violated here: the human complementary-label marginal is non-uniform: per-class counts range over 4,097 4{,}097 – 6,445 6{,}445 (uniform 5,000 5{,}000 ) on CLCIFAR-10 but 1,676 1{,}676 – 3,538 3{,}538 (uniform 2,500 2{,}500 ) on CLCIFAR-20. The milder CLCIFAR-10 bias leaves SCL-NL functional ( 50.7 % 50.7\% unpruned, 53.8 % 53.8\% at the best static cut) while the stronger CLCIFAR-20 bias breaks it outright ( ∼ 9 % {\sim}9\% at chance 5 % 5\% , in every configuration). FWD, whose Q Q models the biased transition explicitly, is unaffected by this violation and is the
only complementary loss that remains usable across both datasets.

blocks.en: We examine whether the benefit of CAVA is tied to a specific CLL objective or carries over as a plug-in data-selection module. To isolate selection, recycling is disabled: each objective is trained only on the retained complementary-labeled pool (Eq. ( 3.13 )). We use two settings that cover both regimes of the flip law. On synthetic CIFAR-10 with η = 25 % \eta=25\% , above the crossover 1 / M 1/M , CAVA uses the adaptive cut s i ≤ 0 s_{i}\leq 0 , which needs no hyperparameter, and TW-LAVA the fixed cut p = 25 % p=25\% . On human-annotated CLCIFAR-10 with η = 3.98 % \eta=3.98\% , below the crossover, both TW-LAVA and CAVA use the fixed cut p = 5 % p=5\% , the smallest grid cut that covers the error rate. Both methods are scored with the same feature extractor and the same 2,000 2{,}000 validation images, and No selection trains on the full pool.

D.7 Recycling and Branch Quality
blocks.zh: D.7 再循环和分支机构的质量

blocks.en: Recycling helps only when the flagged set is pure (Theorem 4 ). This subsection measures that purity with the metrics of Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 只有在标注的集合纯度(定理4 )时,回收才有帮助。 本分节用表4的衡量尺度衡量纯度。

blocks.en: Wherever the cut does not exceed the noise rate, the recycled branch of CAVA is nearly pure: it contains 0.54 % 0.54\% valid labels on CIFAR-10 at p = η p=\eta (Table 13 ), and the adaptive cut reaches 99.7 % 99.7\% and 96.0 % 96.0\% precision on CLCIFAR-10 and CLCIFAR-20 (Tables 16 and 17 ). Recycling then turns the detected noise into supervision: on CIFAR-10 it raises SCL-NL from 79.26 % 79.26\% to 91.57 % 91.57\% , and on CLCIFAR-20 from 10.78 % 10.78\% to 47.71 % 47.71\% with the fixed cut (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在切除率未超过噪音率的地方,CAVA的回收分支几乎是纯的:在CIFAR-10上含有0.54%的0.54\%有效标签在p= p=\eta上(表13),适应性切除率在CLCIFAR-10和CLCIFAR-20上达到99.7%和96.0%的精度(表16和17)。 然后再循环将检测到的噪音转化为监督:在CIFAR-10上,将SCL-NL从79.26% 79.26\%提高到91.57% 91.57\%;在CLCIFAR-20上,将固定切割从10.78% 10.78\%提高到47.71% 47.71\%(表1)。

blocks.en: The baseline shows the failure mode that the bound predicts. On CIFAR-10 (Table 20 ), fixed cuts trade precision for recall: at p = 25 % p=25\% the recycled branch is 95.4 % 95.4\% pure, and larger cuts recover more noise but recycle more valid labels, so accuracy falls from 88.46 % 88.46\% to 61.58 % 61.58\% . On human labels its recycled branches contain only 9.3 9.3 to 43.5 % 43.5\% true errors, and recycling lowers its accuracy on CLCIFAR-10 by 6 6 to 13 13 points; on CLCIFAR-20, where SCL-NL alone is near chance, it adds 3 3 to 5 5 points (Appendix D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 基线显示约束预测的失败模式. 在CIFAR-10(表20)上,固定切削贸易精度用于召回:在p=25%p=25\%时,回收的分支纯度为95.4%95.4\%,较大的切削恢复了更多的噪音但再循环了更有效的标签,因此精度从88.46% 88.46\%降至61.58% 61.58\%. 在人类标签上,其回收的树枝仅含有9.3-43.5%的真实误差,回收使其在CLCIFAR-10上的精度降低6-6-13 13分;在CLCIFAR-20上,仅SCL-NL就近于偶然,它增加了3-3-5 5分(附录D.2).

blocks.en: An extreme score is not proof of noise: atypical valid images, distribution shift between pool and validation set, or limited coverage of rare modes can also produce one. The two uses of a flagged sample are asymmetric. For pruning, a false positive costs one weak exclusion out of tens of thousands, whereas a retained diagonal label teaches a wrong exclusion, so pruning remains safe under imperfect detection. For recycling, a false positive injects a wrong ordinary label. Recycling is therefore an option gated by the measured precision, and selection only is the default.
blocks.zh: 一个极端的分数不是噪声的证明:非典型的有效图像,池与验证集之间的分布转移,或者稀有模式的有限覆盖也可以产生一个. 标记样品的两个用途是不对称的。 对冲,假阳性的代价是数以万计的人中有一个被弱排斥,而保留对角标签则教错一个被排斥,因此在不完善的检测下,奔跑仍然是安全的. 对于回收,假阳性注射错误的普通标签. 因此,再循环是一个以测量精度为门的选项,选择只是默认的。

blocks.en: D.8 The Validation Set
blocks.zh: D.8 审定集

blocks.en: This subsection examines the clean validation set from two sides: how much its labels are worth when spent on direct supervision instead, and how small it can be.
blocks.zh: 本小节从两边检查了干净的验证装置:其标签在直接监督上花费时值多少钱,以及它能有多小.

blocks.en: CAVA follows the standard protocol of OT-based data valuation [ 16 , 17 ] : a small clean validation set defines the target distribution against which training samples are valued. Every valuation baseline in our comparison (LAVA, SAVA) assumes the same validation set, so this assumption grants no advantage specific to CAVA. Moreover, the validation set enters only the OT scores; it is never used to train the classifier. Its cost is also one-time and independent of the pool size: the CIFAR-10-1M study in Appendix D.9 keeps the same 2,000 2{,}000 validation examples while the training pool grows twentyfold.
blocks.zh: CAVA遵循基于OT的数据估价的标准协议[16,17]: 一套小型的清洁验证系统界定了培训样本的估价目标分布。 在我们的比较中,每个估价基线(LAVA,SAVA)都假设相同的验证套,因此这一假设没有给CAVA带来特定的优势. 此外,验证集只输入OT分数;它从未用于训练分类器. 其成本也是一次性的,独立于池大小:附录D.9中的CIFAR-10-1M研究保留了相同的2,000 2{,}000个验证实例,而训练池则增长了20倍.

blocks.en: A natural question remains: would the 2,000 2{,}000 clean labels be more valuable if they were spent directly on supervised training rather than on valuation? To quantify this, we train a classifier with the standard CE loss on n n clean labels, stratified per class, for budgets n ∈ { 500 , 1 , 000 , 2 , 000 , 5 , 000 , 10 , 000 } n\in\{500,1{,}000,2{,}000,5{,}000,10{,}000\} on CIFAR-10 and n ∈ { 500 , 1 , 000 , 2 , 000 , 4 , 000 , 7 , 000 } n\in\{500,1{,}000,2{,}000,4{,}000,7{,}000\} on CIFAR-20. The protocol matches the main experiments exactly (ResNet-18, AutoAugment, SGD with the same schedule and weight decay, 200 200 epochs, accuracy after the final epoch on the held-out test images, three runs per budget with seeds 1126 1126 , 42 42 , and 2023 2023 ), except that the batch size is min ⁡ ( 128 , n ) \min(128,n) so that small budgets receive a comparable number of updates. This baseline faces no label noise at all, whereas CAVA operates under 25 % 25\% complementary-label noise.

Against training from scratch, the validation set is worth more as an anchor: with 2,000 2{,}000 labels direct supervision reaches 71.52 % 71.52\% on CIFAR-10 and 43.08 % 43.08\% on CIFAR-20, CAVA 91.57 % 91.57\% and 75.34 % 75.34\% , and direct supervision does not reach this level even with 10,000 10{,}000 and 7,000 7{,}000 labels ( 88.79 % 88.79\% and 68.09 % 68.09\% ). blocks.en: CAVA is a valuation and denoising method for CLL: the question it answers is which samples of a given noisy complementary-label pool should be kept, recycled, or removed. Every compared method answers this same question under the same validation set, so the comparison is information-equal across the table. Holding out a small clean set for scores, thresholds, and hyperparameter selection, without using it for training, is standard practice throughout the learning-with-noisy-labels literature [ 11 , 21 , 8 ] and is inherited from the data valuation line [ 10 , 16 , 17 ] ; every baseline with tunable hyperparameters implicitly relies on such a set. Methods that instead consume the validation set as training data, whether by direct supervision or by semi-supervised learning over the pool images, solve a different problem and discard the complementary labels that are the object of study; the budget study above therefore measures a fixed clean-annotation budget rather than information equivalence, and Table 21 bounds what direct supervised use achieves at the same budget. Such methods are pipeline alternatives rather than competing valuation methods: any consumer of the validation set can be composed with the CAVA output, which supplies a cleaned complementary-label pool and a recycled ordinary-label set on top, and the validation set itself can also be added to the CE branch of the recycling objective in Eq. ( 3.14 ).
blocks.zh: CAVA是CLL的一种估值和除号方法:它回答的问题是,给定的吵闹互补标签池的样本应该保存,回收,或者去除. 每个比较方法都在同一验证集下解答了同样的问题,因此比较表上的信息均匀. 持有一套关于分数、阈值和超参数选择的小型清洁设备,而不用于培训,是无标记的学习文献中的标准做法[11、21、8],从数据估价行[10、16、17]中继承;每个有金枪鱼超参数的基准都隐含地依赖这种设备。 相反,通过直接监督或通过对集合图像的半监督学习,将验证集作为培训数据使用的方法,解决了不同的问题,并放弃了作为研究对象的补充标签;因此,上面的预算研究衡量的是固定的清洁说明预算,而不是信息等同,表21限定了直接监督使用在同一预算中取得的成果。 这种方法是管道替代方法,而不是相互竞争的估价方法:任何验证集的消费者都可以与CAVA输出组成,CAVA输出供应一个经过清理的补充标签池和一个回收的普通标签集,验证集本身也可以添加到Eq.(3.14)中回收目标的CE分支中.

blocks.en: We shrink the validation set on both synthetic benchmarks. For each N v ∈ { 200,500 , 1 , 000 , 1 , 500 , 2 , 000 } N_{v}\in\{200,500,1{,}000,1{,}500,2{,}000\} we draw a class-stratified subset of the test split ( N v / 10 N_{v}/10 per class on CIFAR-10, N v / 20 N_{v}/20 per class on CIFAR-20, seed 1126 1126 ), recompute the task-wise OT scores against it, and rerun the full fixed-cut pipeline ( p = 0.25 p=0.25 , combined CE+SCL-NL with κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 , AutoAugment; three full-pipeline seeds per setting). Table 22 reports the detector AUC, the precision of the recycled branch, and the final test accuracy for TW-LAVA and CAVA. The two methods react differently. TW-LAVA degrades as the validation set shrinks: from N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 to 200 200 the precision of its recycled branch falls by 4 4 points on CIFAR-10 and 6 6 points on CIFAR-20, and its accuracy by 3.8 3.8 and 6.7 6.7 points. CAVA is almost insensitive to N v N_{v} : its precision stays above 99 % 99\% and 93 % 93\% , and its accuracy within 0.2 0.2 points on CIFAR-10 and 2.1 2.1 points on CIFAR-20 of the N v = 2,000 N_{v}=2{,}000 result. With only 200 200 validation images, CAVA reaches 91.47 % 91.47\% on CIFAR-10 and 73.21 % 73.21\% on CIFAR-20, above TW-LAVA with ten times more validation data ( 88.75 % 88.75\% and 59.03 % 59.03\% ). The label margin needs only enough validation images to place each class, not to estimate the feature distribution of every noisy label group.

blocks.en: D.9 Scaling to One Million Samples
blocks.zh: D.9 扩大至100万样本

blocks.en: To further evaluate the scalability of CAVA with respect to the number of training samples, we conduct an additional large-sample ablation study on CIFAR-10 under 25 % 25\% diagonal complementary-label noise ( η = 25 % \eta=25\% ). Specifically, we expand the original CIFAR-10 training set from 50,000 images to 1,000,000 training samples using label-preserving data augmentation, denoted as CIFAR-10-1M. 1 1 1 CIFAR-10-1M is an augmented benchmark generated from CIFAR-10 using label-preserving augmentation, increasing the training set from 50K to 1M samples. Therefore, it evaluates scalability with respect to training-set size rather than naturally collected semantic diversity. After augmentation, complementary labels are generated following the same diagonal-noise protocol as in the main experiments, with noise ratio η = 25 % \eta=25\% . The original CIFAR-10 test set is kept unchanged for evaluation. This design allows us to assess whether CAVA remains effective under a substantially enlarged noisy complementary-label training regime without introducing test-set leakage or changing the evaluation protocol.

Figure 5 (a) in the main text visualizes the accuracy–efficiency trade-off on CIFAR-10-1M, and Table 23 reports the corresponding numerical results. Without pruning, SCL-NL fails on the enlarged noisy pool and reaches only 0.12 % 0.12\% . TW-LAVA peaks at the cut p = 35 % p=35\% , above the noise rate, with 71.05 % 71.05\% after 200 epochs ( 68.26 % 68.26\% at p = 25 % p=25\% and 70.28 % 70.28\% at p = 45 % p=45\% ) and 67.76 % 67.76\% under the 20-epoch schedule of CAVA ( 61.01 % 61.01\% and 55.95 % 55.95\% at p = 25 % p=25\% and 45 % 45\% ), so the gap to CAVA does not come from the training budget. CAVA ranks the noise at the low end of each task (detection AUC 0.996 0.996 ) and peaks at the cut p = 25 % p=25\% that equals the noise rate, where it reaches 86.04 % 86.04\% with SCL-NL after only 20 epochs; deeper cuts remove valid samples and lower accuracy ( 78.05 % 78.05\% and 67.30 % 67.30\% at p = 35 % p=35\% and 45 % 45\% after 20 epochs, 84.95 % 84.95\% and 73.25 % 73.25\% after 200 epochs, against 90.51 % 90.51\% at p = 25 % p=25\% ). Cuts below the noise rate leave diagonal noise in the retained pool and fail for both methods: at p = 15 % p=15\% TW-LAVA reaches 27.79 % 27.79\% and 42.90 % 42.90\% after 20 and 200 epochs and CAVA 24.99 % 24.99\% after 20 epochs, while its 200-epoch run collapses to a single class ( 10.00 % 10.00\% ) from epoch 38 on and does not recover.

blocks.en: The computational results show that the task-wise decomposition keeps both methods feasible at this scale, and that the label margin makes valuation nearly free. The valuation is decomposed into five tasks of 200,000 samples each: TW-LAVA needs about 30 minutes per task, about 2.5 hours in total, whereas CAVA scores all one million samples in about 4 minutes, mainly because the complementary label cost needs no label-to-label transport between noisy groups. Training is the dominant cost, and it depends only on the size of the retained pool: on one dedicated GPU an epoch takes 566 seconds without pruning and 436 and 432 seconds at p = 25 % p=25\% for TW-LAVA and CAVA (Table 23 ). These are the times of the second epoch, without the one-time start-up of about 20 seconds; the two methods agree within 4 % 4\% at the same cut, and the CAVA times at p = 15 % p=15\% come from a linear fit in the pool size whose residuals at the measured cuts are below 2 % 2\% . TW-LAVA at its best cut ( p = 35 % p=35\% ) needs 20.7 20.7 hours for 200 epochs, whereas CAVA reaches a higher accuracy, 86.04 % 86.04\% , with the 20-epoch schedule in 2.4 2.4 hours, a tenfold smaller training budget; with 200 epochs CAVA reaches 90.51 % 90.51\% ( 24.0 24.0 hours).

blocks.en: Overall, these results indicate that CAVA scales favorably with increased training-set size through task-wise decomposition. However, because CIFAR-10-1M is generated through label-preserving augmentation rather than collected as a naturally large and semantically diverse dataset, we view evaluation on naturally large-scale CLL datasets as an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,通过任务分解,CAVA在扩大培训设置规模的同时,会比较有利。 然而,由于CIFAR-10-1M是通过保留标签的增强生成的,而不是作为一个自然大而多样的数据集收集的,我们认为对自然大的CLL数据集的评价是未来工作的一个重要方向.

blocks.en: D.10 Computational Efficiency of Task-Wise Decomposition
blocks.zh: D.10 任务分工分解的计算效率

blocks.en: The Sinkhorn algorithm can become computationally expensive when OT is computed over the full training and validation sets. To examine whether the proposed task-wise decomposition improves computational feasibility, we conduct an additional efficiency comparison among LAVA, SAVA, and CAVA on CIFAR-10. Specifically, we use 10K training samples and 10K validation samples and report the wall-clock runtime required for one OT-based data-selection step.
blocks.zh: 在通过全部培训和验证组合计算OT时,Sinkhorn算法可能变得昂贵。 为了审查拟议的任务分解是否提高了计算可行性,我们在CIFAR-10上对LAVA、SAVA和CAVA进行了额外的效率比较。 具体地说,我们使用10K培训样本和10K验证样本,并报告一个基于OT的数据选择步骤所需的时钟运行时间。

blocks.en: Table 24 : Runtime of one OT-based selection step on CIFAR-10 with 10K training and 10K validation samples. The CAVA time is the mean of three runs on one GPU, with features computed beforehand.
blocks.zh: 表24:CIFAR-10上一个OT型选择步骤的运行时间,有10K训练和10K验证样本. CAVA时间是一个GPU上的三次运行的平均值,其特性事先计算.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 24 , LAVA and task-wise selection with one solve per task require a comparable runtime in the 10K-sample setting because both solve an OT problem of similar size. CAVA solves a problem of the same size in 0.2 0.2 seconds on precomputed features; its label cost is a fixed 0 / 1 0/1 table and needs no OT between label groups. However, the key difference lies in their scalability. LAVA performs OT over the full data selection problem, and therefore its computational and memory costs increase rapidly as the training set becomes larger. In contrast, CAVA keeps the OT problem size fixed by decomposing the enlarged training set into task-level subproblems. We further compare the peak memory usage of different methods as the training-set size increases. The results are reported in Table 25 .
blocks.zh: 如表24所示,LAVA和任务选择,每个任务一个解,都需要在10K-样本设置中有一个可比的运行时间,因为两者都解决了大小相似的OT问题. CAVA在预计算功能上以0.2 0.2秒解决了一个大小相同的问题;它的标签成本是固定的0/1 0/1表,在标签组之间不需要OT. 然而,关键区别在于它们的可伸缩性. LAVA在全部数据选择问题上执行OT,因此其计算和内存成本随着训练集的扩大而迅速增加. 相比之下,CAVA通过将扩大的训练集分解成任务级子问题来固定OT问题大小. 我们进一步比较不同方法的峰值内存使用,因为训练设置的体积增加。 调查结果见表25。

blocks.en: Table 25 : Peak GPU memory of OT-based selection as the training set grows. LAVA, SAVA, and TW-LAVA run their original pipelines with 10,000 10{,}000 validation images (TW-LAVA with tasks of 10K samples). For CAVA we report its valuation step, without feature extraction, with the 2,000 2{,}000 validation images of the paper and with 10,000 10{,}000 for a direct comparison. OOM: out of memory; “–”: not measured.
blocks.zh: 表25:随着训练集的增长,在OT基础上选择的峰值GPU内存. LAVA,SAVA,和TW-LAVA以10,000 10{,}000的验证图像(TW-LAVA,任务为10K样品)运行其原始管道. 对于CAVA, 我们报告它的估价步骤, 不提取特征, 与2,000 2{,} 000 的纸张验证图像 和10,000 10{,} 000 直接比较。 OOM: 失忆; " - " :没有计量。

blocks.en: Table 25 shows that LAVA becomes increasingly memory-intensive as the training-set size grows. In particular, its memory usage reaches 43.00 GB at 20K training samples and runs out of memory from 30K samples onward in our environment. This behavior is expected because full-set OT requires constructing and optimizing over a large transport problem whose size grows with the number of training and validation samples.
blocks.zh: 表25显示,随着培训规模的扩大,LAVA的记忆力越来越密集。 特别是,它的内存使用量在20K训练样品时达到43.00GB,并且从我们环境中的30K样品中耗尽。 这种行为是预料到的,因为完整设置的OT需要构建和优化于一个巨大的运输问题,其体积随着培训和验证样本数量的增长而增加.

blocks.en: SAVA, by contrast, maintains low memory usage of approximately 3.00 GB because it performs OT at the batch level. However, this memory advantage comes with substantially longer runtime in our experiment, as shown in Table 24 . Moreover, batch-wise selection may restrict the comparison scope of OT to small local batches.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,SAVA维持约3.00GB的低内存使用率,因为它在批量级执行OT. 然而,如表24所示,这种记忆优势随着我们的实验运行时间大大延长而产生。 此外,按批量选择可能会将OT的比较范围限制在局部小批量上。

blocks.en: TW-LAVA, the task-wise transfer of LAVA, avoids the out-of-memory failure by fixing the task size, but its original pipeline still needs about 21.65 GB. CAVA needs far less: its complementary label cost is a lookup table, so the valuation step stores only the task-by-validation cost matrix and a few vectors. At the paper protocol of 2,000 2{,}000 validation images it uses 0.10 0.10 to 0.35 0.35 GB for 10K to 50K training samples, and 0.42 0.42 GB for one million samples, where pools larger than 12,000 12{,}000 samples are scored in chunks; even with 10,000 10{,}000 validation images it stays below 2 2 GB. Memory therefore grows with the validation set and the chunk size, and with the training set only until the pools are scored in chunks, and the task-wise subproblems remain independent, so they can be run in parallel across devices without changing the method.
blocks.zh: TW-LAVA,即LAVA的任务转移,通过固定任务大小避免了超模故障,但其原有的管道仍需要约21.65GB. CAVA需要的要少得多:其互补的标签成本是查询表,因此估值步骤只存储任务逐项验证成本矩阵和少数向量. 在2000 2{,}000验证图像的纸质协议中,它使用0.10 0.10至0.35 0.35 GB作为10K至50K训练样本,使用0.42 0.42 GB作为100 000个样本,其中大于12,000 12{,}000个样本的池被打成块;即使有10,000 10{,}000验证图像仍停留在2 2 GB以下. 因此,内存随验证集和块大小而增长,而训练集只到池积分成块为止,而任务偏次问题保持独立,因此可以在不改变方法的情况下在设备之间平行运行.
